data.long_meaning: Awdhesh is a name of Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe in Hinduism. The name Awdhesh means 'God of prosperity' and signifies the power and strength of the divine. It is a name that is believed to bring wealth and success in life. The name Awdhesh carries the meaning “God of prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Awdhesh usually hope their child will grow to embody god of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Awdhesh is a divine name and represents the power, strength, and prosperity of the universe. It is a reminder of the divine presence within us and the power to overcome challenges and achieve success.
data.etymology: Awdhesh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Awdhesh total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
